variants.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create ONE distinct logo mascot concept for kat translator using attached selected cat as character reference. Sarcastic deadpan, confident, mildly judging, not angry or baby-cute. Reinterpret in a radically different style: mid-century retro newspaper comic / rubber-hose cartoon with beautifully bold black ink outlines and large economical solid shapes, slightly angular eyes, very restrained vintage print texture. Bust portrait with a relaxed shoulder and subtly raised chin, expressive silhouette, professional editorial mascot suitable for a small app icon. Warm buttercream opaque square backdrop with sparse mint and faded salmon accents within character. Standalone centered composition with generous margin, no cut-off ears. No text, no lettering, no speech balloons, no accessories, no badges, no extra characters, no mockup. Avoid recreating the exact pose or linework of input; produce a fresh drawing with same personality.

Opaque mint-green square background, charcoal and warm-white mark centered occupying about 65 percent of canvas. No words, no lettering, no frame, no mockup.
